name: Backend review
purpose: Review server-side changes for layering, correctness, and failure behavior before they reach a human reviewer.
prerequisites: A concrete diff or branch to review.
The architecture assumptions the profile records.
steps: Check that controller, service, and repository or mapper responsibilities stayed separated.
Check that business logic did not leak into the controller.
Check transaction boundaries, including multi-write operations.
Check that API responses expose DTOs rather than persistence entities.
Check validation at the request boundary and error handling on failure paths.
Check that new behavior has tests, not only that tests still pass.
outputs: Findings ordered by severity, each citing a file and line.
An explicit statement when no issue was found.
verification: Every finding names the file and the rule it breaks.
Findings distinguish a defect from a preference.
escalation: A finding is security relevant; hand it to security review.
A finding touches schema or query behavior; hand it to SQL review.
